12.t: Working with data: height and lung capacity
q: What is the vital capacity of the 158 cm student?
Taller students have a larger vital capacity (positive correlation).
Use the line of best fit to predict the vital capacity of a 168 cm student.
Suggest a reason for the pattern and one other variable that could affect the results.
Taller people have larger chest cavities and lungs. Other variables: fitness, playing a wind instrument, sex, smoking, technique.
